_comment: AR Aging TV board config. Edit this file, commit it, and Netlify redeploys in about 30 seconds. Nothing secret belongs in here.

report._comment: ServiceTitan report 435, 'AR Transactions By Customer'. Already summarized per customer with ServiceTitan's own aging math.
report._parametersNote: These mirror the checkboxes as they were set in the ServiceTitan UI. AsOfDate is left out on purpose so the report always runs as of today rather than a frozen date.

ar._bucketNote: These map to ServiceTitan's own aging columns. Do not invent 30/60/90 boundaries that disagree with them — the whole point of using this report is that accounting already agreed on where the lines are. A customer with money in more than one column will appear on more than one view, showing that column's amount each time. That is correct, not a bug.
ar._balanceNote: The 'Total' field in this report is INVOICE TOTAL, not amount owed. A customer can show a $14,602 Total while owing $105.93. Never display Total as a balance. Amount owed = sum of the aging columns.
ar._sortNote: balance = biggest money in that bucket first. name = alphabetical.

privacy._note: nameStyle: full | initial | hidden. Use initial if anyone who is not an employee can see this screen.

ar._collectorsNote: This report does not carry technician or sold-by data, so collector assignment has to be maintained here by hand. Map the customer name exactly as ServiceTitan spells it.
